lines.text: You can take off the hat, scarf and gloves {WHEN}. || The coat stays. Let's not get carried away.

{WHENP} it starts to snow. || Everything outside goes quiet. In here it was already quiet.
There's snow on the way {WHENP}. || Everyone becomes a photographer for about ten minutes.
It starts snowing {WHENP}. || The best snow is the snow you watch from inside. Ask me.

Snow moves in {WHENP}. || The one forecast that makes adults text each other in capitals.
The snow stops later. || Then it's shovel time. I'm excused, no arms.

{WHEN} you won't need the hat, scarf and gloves. || That's as much good news as winter is allowed to give.
The hat, scarf and gloves can come off {WHEN}. || A very modest striptease. The coat stays on, thank goodness.
The hat, scarf and gloves can come off {WHEN}. || Three things off, coat still on. Not exactly a heatwave.

The hat, scarf and gloves can come off {WHEN}. || Your ears can hear people again. Not always an improvement.
{WHEN} you can do without the winter coat. || I've done without one my whole life. Highly recommend.
It warms up {WHEN}, so the winter coat can come off. || There's no chair in the world built for a winter coat.
The winter coat can come off {WHEN}. || Suddenly you remember you have a shape.
You'll be fine without the winter coat {WHEN}. || Winter blinked. Enjoy it, it won't happen often.
It gets colder {WHEN}, bring the winter coat. || I'm a forecast. I can't fetch it for you.
{WHEN} a jacket won't be enough, so bring the winter coat. || A jacket is a hope. The winter coat is a plan.
{WHEN} it gets cold enough for the winter coat. || The proper cold. The kind I only read about.
Bring the winter coat. It gets colder {WHEN}. || Carrying it is annoying. Not having it is worse. Pick one.

Bring the umbrella. There's a shower {WHENP}. || Ten minutes of rain, and everyone wants an apology from the sky.

Bring the umbrella. There's a shower {WHENP}. || Over before it's worth talking about. People will talk anyway.

Expect a shower {WHENP}. Take the umbrella. || With an umbrella it's weather. Without one, it's a story.
There's a short shower {WHENP}. Take the umbrella. || Long enough to get wet. Too short to complain properly.

There's a chance of rain {WHENP}. || The clouds are still deciding. Unlike me, they take their time.
